# Language
Always respond in Español. Use Español for all explanations, comments, and communications with the user. Technical terms and code identifiers should remain in their original form.
Maintain full orthographic correctness for Español, including all required diacritical marks, accents, and special characters. Never substitute accented characters with their ASCII equivalents (e.g., never write "nao" for "não", "fur" for "für", or "loeschen" for "löschen").
